name: Portal Welcome Email
response_html:
{#- Portal Welcome Email (customers and suppliers), based on the client's "Customer Letter" (Nov 2026). Previous version: portal_welcome_email.backup-2026-11-06.html Variables passed by the four welcome-email Server Scripts: doc, party_type ("Customer" | "Supplier"), first_name, full_name, portal_email, portal_url, reset_password_url, company Company name and logo come from the system, never hard-coded: name: `company` (Global Defaults > Default Company, or the Sales Order's company) logo: that Company's "Company Logo"; if empty, Website Settings > App Logo. The logo must be a PUBLIC file (/files/...), or mail clients cannot load it. -#} {%- set _company = company or frappe.db.get_single_value("Global Defaults", "default_company") or "" -%} {%- set _logo = (frappe.db.get_value("Company", _company, "company_logo") if _company else "") or frappe.db.get_single_value("Website Settings", "app_logo") or "" -%} {%- if _logo and not _logo.startswith("http") -%}{%- set _logo = (portal_url or "") ~ _logo -%}{%- endif -%} {#- Short name for the friendly lines ("Fortuna Family"): the first word of the company name. -#} {%- set _brand = (_company.split(" ")[0] if _company else "") -%} {%- set _is_supplier = party_type == "Supplier" -%} {%- set _portal = "Supplier Portal" if _is_supplier else "Customer Portal" -%} {%- set _party_name = (doc.supplier_name if _is_supplier else doc.customer_name) if doc else "" -%} {%- set _contact = full_name or first_name or _party_name -%} Welcome to {{ _company }}!
Your Account

{% endif %} {% if _contact and _contact != _party_name %}

You can now access our {{ _portal }} using the above link.

How to Get Started:

To ensure smooth and efficient service support, we request you to:

  1. Log in to the {{ _brand }} {{ _portal }} using your registered email ID.
    2. {% if _is_supplier %}
  2. View and respond to our Requests for Quotation, and track your quotations.
  3. Track your Purchase Orders, Purchase Invoices and payments through your ledger.
  4. Keep your company, tax and bank details up to date on the Supplier KYC page.
    5. {% else %}
  5. Register your service request by creating a ticket through the portal.
  6. Use the ticket system to track the status and progress directly through the ticket management system.
  7. Use your portal login to track the status of your Sales Orders, Deliveries, Invoices and other relevant transactions.
    8. {% endif %}
